_sources.rho20_ohm_mm: IACS annealed copper 1.7241 uOhm*cm at 20 C, NBS Handbook 100 (read by the research pass)
_sources.t_max_c: condition: 105 C (DS12117 Table 118 gives IDD max up to Tj 105 C at 480 MHz)
_sources.k_material: condition: 1.0 = annealed IACS; IPC-4562 foil maximum not reached, no cited maximum for plated copper; every R scales linearly with it
_sources.t_outer_min_mm: condition: 30 um (OSH Park: 1 oz + plating 1.7 mil nominal, no tolerance; NCAB second-hand: 1 oz foil minimum 30.9 um)
_sources.t_plane_min_mm: condition: 15 um (OSH Park inner 0.5 oz 0.68 mil nominal; NCAB second-hand 1/2 oz foil minimum 15.4 um)
_sources.plating_min_mm: condition: 18 um (JLCPCB average 18 um, read; IPC-6012D class 2 thin-area 18 um, second-hand; OSH Park 1 mil, min or average not stated)
_sources.antipad_radius_mm: 0.3 + 0.2005 measured plane clearance to a foreign via (architecture 2.21), rounded up to 0.51, plus 0.125: the zone's min_thickness 0.25 opens the fill by a 0.125 mm disc (KiCad deflate/inflate), so a point 0.125 from every knockout survives
_sources.edge_mm: route.rs EDGE_NM 0.5 mm, plus the 0.125 mm opening
_sources.h_*: barrel length bounds: the reference's declared finished 0.34..2.0 mm; at 4 layers F.Cu to In2 at least 0.179 + 0.891 mm, at most the finished 1.851 mm
_sources.plane_via_joint: read at source: KiCad 10.0.7 pcbnew/zone_filler.cpp knockoutThermalReliefs gives thermal reliefs to footprint pads; vias get them only in HATCH_PATTERN zones (l.2002-2112); the planes are solid fill, so a same-net via joins the fill all round
